Outcome

Admit Resample4s only from an immutable clean revision through a real ScalaFIM consumer court.

Acceptance

- Pin records exact revision and provenance.
- Scala 3.7.4 JVM and Scala.js compile and execute representative selection, exact-once, grouped, fixed, nested, permutation, and receipt paths.
- No sibling checkout accidentally supplies unpinned behavior.
- Publication, local composite, and remote-pin evidence are reported separately.
set.title: P3.1: pin and rehearse Resample4s as a ScalaFIM JVM and Scala.js consumer
